About the shop

A Newton neighbourhood barbershop, built on repeat clients

Sunny Nagar Barbershop serves the Newton area of Surrey with sharp, consistent work — from skin-tight fades to full beard transformations. The focus is simple: listen first, cut with precision, and finish every service properly, including threading and facials for a complete, polished result.

With a 4.8-star rating across 387 reviews, clients come back for the detail, the consistency, and a chair they can trust week after week.
